inlines.v: INCORRUPT'IBLE, adjective 1. That cannot corrupt or decay; not admitting of corruption. Thus gold, glass, mercury, etc., are incorruptible Spirits are supposed to be incorruptible Our bodies shall be changed into incorruptible and immortal substances. 2. That cannot be bribed; inflexibly just and upright.
